rationale: Concrete optional refactor scope: Planning rendering, function request_assembly and qualified_reference repeat length-framed task/support text request replacement, role/settings/conversation preservation and structured-message rejection. Before extracting one small helper, prove callers and deliberately distinct native render/provenance contracts, preserve exact output bytes/errors/identities with both specialized and mixed-plan tests. Parse/reuse work has its own bounded pending investigation; no generic base class or framework authorized.
